title_en: She said that … / He told me that …
title_vi: She said that … / He told me that … (câu tường thuật)
theory_html:
A. Reporting what people said

A. Thuật lại lời người khác nói

Last week you went to a party. A lot of your friends were there. Today you meet Paul. You tell him what your friends said:

Tuần trước bạn đi dự tiệc. Nhiều bạn bè của bạn có ở đó. Hôm nay bạn gặp Paul. Bạn kể cho anh ấy những gì bạn bè đã nói:

present → past
hiện tại → quá khứ		what they said
lời nói		reported
tường thuật
am / is → wasClare: ‘I’m enjoying my new job. My father isn’t well.’Clare said that she was enjoying her new job. She said that her father wasn’t well.
are → wereSarah and Ben: ‘We’re going to buy a house.’Sarah and Ben said that they were going to buy a house.
have / has → hadPeter: ‘I have to leave early. My sister has gone to Australia.’Peter said that he had to leave early. He said that his sister had gone to Australia.
can → couldKate: ‘I can’t find a job.’Kate said that she couldn’t find a job.
will → wouldSteve: ‘I’ll phone you.’Steve said that he would phone me.
do / does → didRachel: ‘I don’t like my job. My son doesn’t like school.’Rachel said that she didn’t like her job. She said that her son didn’t like school.
look → looked, feel → feltMike: ‘You look tired.’ You: ‘I feel fine.’Mike said that I looked tired. I said that I felt fine.

B. say and tell

B. say và tell

say (→ said)tell (→ told)
He said that he was tired. (not He said me)He told me that he was tired. (not He told that)
What did she say to you? (not say you)What did she tell you? (not tell to you)

We say he told me, I told Ann etc. (not ‘he told to me’, ‘I told to Ann’). We say he said to me, I said to Ann etc. (not ‘he said me’, ‘I said Ann’).

Ta nói he told me, I told Ann v.v. (không nói ‘he told to me’, ‘I told to Ann’). Ta nói he said to me, I said to Ann v.v. (không nói ‘he said me’, ‘I said Ann’).

You can say: He said that he was tired. or He said he was tired. (without that)

Có thể nói: He said that he was tired. hoặc He said he was tired. (bỏ that)

  • Kate told me that she couldn’t find a job. or Kate told me she couldn’t find a job.

    Kate nói với tôi rằng cô ấy không tìm được việc.

mcq.question: Clare: ‘I’m enjoying my new job.’ → Clare said that she ___ enjoying her new job.
mcq.full: Clare: ‘I’m enjoying my new job.’ → Clare said that she was enjoying her new job.
mcq.vi: Clare: ‘Tôi rất thích công việc mới.’ → Clare nói rằng cô ấy đang rất thích công việc mới.
mcq.expl:
Reported speech: present → past (am/is → was, are → were, have/has → had, can → could, will → would, do/does → did, look → looked).
Câu tường thuật: hiện tại → quá khứ (am/is → was, are → were, have/has → had, can → could, will → would, do/does → did, look → looked).
Điểm ngữ pháp: am → was.
mcq.key: Clare: ‘I’m enjoying my new job.’ → Clare said that she ___ enjoying her new job.|was
